## About these lessons

Each lesson is a set of slides with **live R code**. The code runs in your own browser using [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/) — you do not need R or RStudio installed to try the examples. Edit any code block and press **Run Code** to see the result.

The first time a deck loads it downloads the R engine, which takes a few seconds. After that it is instant.

::: callout-tip
## Navigating the slides

Use the arrow keys or the on-screen controls to move between slides. Press <kbd>S</kbd> for speaker notes, <kbd>F</kbd> for full screen, and <kbd>Esc</kbd> for a slide overview.
:::

## Getting help

Questions about the material go to the course instructor. If a code block will not run, try reloading the page — the browser occasionally drops the R engine after a long idle period.
